actual: Two formal file-only preflights fail before inference; targeted flat-price cases pass but do not cover monthly prefix re-encoding.

fix_analysis.root_cause: Monthly native Qlib updates rescale a serialized float32 prefix through a second float64 multiply/float32 cast. Single-cast price/factor intervals can exclude the true integer-li source price.
fix_analysis.implementation: Read the current release manifest-pinned native materialization receipt and full calendar; bind scaled OHLC/factor hashes, byte sizes and exact physical prefix boundaries; invert the recorded float32 re-encoding and require a unique integer-li source price across every possible predecessor encoding. New suffix rows retain single-cast decoding. Reference prices, volume semantics and model contracts are unchanged.
fix_analysis.review_round_1: Corrected full-calendar versus bounded-read-calendar indexing; both warmup and aggregation use the same provenance decoder.
fix_analysis.review_round_2: Checked unknown/missing/duplicate lineage, scale/size/hash/calendar drift, exact prefix boundary and ambiguity failures. No database or old-release fallback, dataset writes, fit, or QE asset replacement.

design_compliance_001.no_simplified_delivery: Both production read paths are wired; complete two-date formal validation remains pending until clean committed source.
design_compliance_001.no_silent_failure: Missing provenance, changed input and nonunique source prices remain typed failures.
design_compliance_001.business_semantics_unchanged: No changes to model, features, seed, threshold, PIT or price source unit.
design_compliance_001.no_unapproved_gate: Enforces existing immutable input and unique-source-price contracts; no additional model or manual approval gate.
